args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions. Rollback verified (status: rolled_out).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was a staging build).

3. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions — verified as `rolled_out`.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the health-check failures and the rollback action taken, which paged the on-call engineer.
